editorial.blurb: Great Wall serves up generous portions of classic American-style Chinese food in a friendly, no-fuss setting where the staff happily accommodates substitutions.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead or visit in person to confirm menu items and make substitutions, as the online menu sometimes differs from what's available in the restaurant.

topDishes.note: Best flavors in Chicago; choose up to two flavors
Huge, shareable portions with chicken, shrimp, and beef
